_hinweis: Bildprompts aus copy/bildbriefing.md. Zwei Stilfamilien in stilblocks: "produkt" fuer fotorealistische Produktaufnahmen (Hero, Designbeispiele), "objekt" fuer die reduzierten 3D-Objekte als Akzent. Jedes Bild waehlt seine Familie ueber "stil". "rahmen": false schaltet das Nachrahmen ab, sinnvoll bei Szenen ohne freien Hintergrund. Eintraege mit "aktiv": false laufen nicht mit. Aufruf: node scripts/gen-bilder-openai.mjs --only <kennung>

stilblocks.objekt: Minimal 3D render, one single subject, nothing else in frame. Matte material, soft neutral studio light from one side, one soft shadow. Clean white background with a large amount of empty space around the object. Colour palette strictly limited to deep navy blue (#023047), amazon orange (#FF9900), white and light warm grey. No other colours, no gradients across the frame, no glow effects, no connecting lines, no floating icons, no collage of multiple symbols. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no interface labels. No people, no faces, no hands. No Amazon logo and no Amazon interface. Calm, restrained, editorial. High detail, quiet composition.
stilblocks.produkt: Photorealistic e-commerce product photography of a premium consumer brand. Clean even studio lighting, soft natural shadow under the product, no harsh reflections. Tack sharp focus, very high detail, shot straight on at product height with a normal lens, no wide-angle distortion. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no printed labels, no engraving and no branding of any kind, neither on the product nor anywhere in the scene. No people, no faces, no hands, no body parts. Calm neutral colour world. Nothing else in the frame that competes with the product.
